title: 8 Jokes a Godly Man Stops Laughing At
caption:
You don't have to be the fun police. A godly man laughs a lot. Real brothers give each other a hard time.

But some jokes aren't jokes. They're how a group makes sin normal, makes a woman an object, or makes the guy trying to change feel stupid for trying. And the one who goes quiet is usually the one with the most backbone in the room.

You don't need a speech. Just stop laughing. Change the subject. And if a brother is the target, stand next to him.

"Let there be no filthiness nor foolish talk nor crude joking, which are out of place, but instead let there be thanksgiving." Ephesians 5:4

Save this. Send it to the guy who goes quiet with you.
